description:
ISS-003 D3 validation-only implementation. Related to T-021 (parent context — storybloq rejected umbrella linkage because T-010c blocks on T-021). Implements the design chosen in handover `2026-05-18-04-iss-003-design.md` (commit `94f16ac Decide VAL-CAP-004 workload semantics`).

Scope (binding, validation-only):
- `validation/rows.ts`: additive optional fields on `SmokeRow` — `expectedCaptureFormat?: { width: number; height: number }`, `expectedEncoderBackend?: string`, `onCellMismatch?: "fail" | "skip"`. Annotate `VAL-CAP-004` with `expectedCaptureFormat: { width: 1920, height: 1080 }`, `expectedEncoderBackend: "nvenc"`, `onCellMismatch: "fail"`. ISS-001 `nominalFps: 60` preserved verbatim. No other row modified.
- `validation/drivers.ts`:
  - `deriveThresholdKey` accepts optional declared `{ width, height }` and declared encoder backend; resolves height from declared when present (falls back to negotiated), and uses declared backend verbatim when present (falls back to existing string-matching heuristics).
  - `driveValCap004`:
    - Derives `declaredCaptureFormat` + `expectedEncoderBackend` from row; computes `cellsMatch` / `cellMismatch` boolean against `sessionReady.format`.
    - thresholds.json additively records `declaredCaptureFormat`, `negotiatedCaptureFormat`, `cellMismatch`, `expectedEncoderBackend`. Existing `captureFormat`, `encoderObserved`, `nominalFps`, `nominalSource` keys preserved.
    - When `onCellMismatch === "skip"` AND `cellMismatch === true`, returns explicit skip with `skipReason: "host-cell-mismatch"` and a message containing the literal token `host-does-not-deliver-declared-cell`. Otherwise (default `"fail"` or missing) continues into the threshold array.
    - Adds `"capture cell matches declared (WxH)"` ThresholdResult before the drop/cadence/backend gates when the row declares a cell — never a silent pass.
    - Encoder backend gate name + `required` field use `expectedEncoderBackend`; strict equality preserved. `encoder.selected` remains a real helper event; ISS-002 still gates real backend availability.
- `validation/types.ts`: additive `SkipReason` union member `"host-cell-mismatch"` for the optional skip path.

Out of scope (binding):
- No helper/, electron/, src/, packaging/, .github/workflows/, package.json, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock changes.
- No encoder backend implementation (still ISS-002 / T-017a).
- No PipeWire pod constraint.
- No downscale / fps clamp.
- No row schema rewrite beyond additive optional fields.
- No tolerance constant changes (cadenceMeanToleranceFrac, cadenceP95ToleranceFrac, duplicatedPtsPerMinute, THRESHOLDS values unchanged).
- No T-021 rerun, no T-010c execution.

Invariants preserved:
- Rows must not pass without real evidence.
- Workload mismatch is explicit (precise ThresholdResult name + observed/required strings).
- Default policy keeps mismatch as a row-level fail, never silent pass.
- ISS-001 `nominalFps` / `nominalSource` behavior unchanged.
- `encoder.selected` is not synthesised.
- Negotiated capture format is still recorded in thresholds.json so the underlying ISS-003 mismatch remains visible in evidence.

Verification:
- `npm run typecheck` clean.
- `npm run validate:build` clean.
- `npm run build` clean.
- Structural greps: `expectedCaptureFormat`, `expectedEncoderBackend`, `onCellMismatch` present in rows.ts and drivers.ts; `capture cell matches declared` and `host-does-not-deliver-declared-cell` present in drivers.ts; tolerance constants unchanged in assertions.ts.

Acceptance:
1. Codex review on `/home/sin/Desktop/Codex-Reviews/` says `patch is correct`.
2. T-021 rerun 4 (separate ticket) reports the precise cell-mismatch ThresholdResult on a 4K-only host instead of a vague cadence failure.
3. ISS-003 flips to `resolved` only after the rerun produces accepted evidence; this ticket may complete on Codex-accept and rerun is separately scheduled.

Codex review focus:
- Additive-only schema (other rows unchanged).
- deriveThresholdKey keys off declared cell when present.
- Negotiated capture format still recorded as evidence.
- Cell mismatch is a real threshold fail by default — not silent pass.
- Skip path explicit and named `host-does-not-deliver-declared-cell`.
- Encoder backend gate uses row.expectedEncoderBackend.
- `encoder.selected` not synthesised.
- ISS-001 nominalFps/nominalSource preserved.
- Tolerance constants + duplicated PTS checks unchanged.
- No helper/electron/src/package/Cargo files touched.
- ISS-002 untouched; T-010a/T-021/T-010c statuses unchanged.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: VAL-CAP-004 cell-match schema + driver (ISS-003 D3 implementation)
